# Quickstart playbook (generated by @project-bootstrap quickstart)

**Mode:** {{MODE}} · **Date:** {{DATE}}

## Daily loop (all modes)

```text
@session-control start
… work …
@code-verify uncommitted          # before commit
@session-control close            # add commit when ready
```

## Mode: lite

| Step | Command |
|------|---------|
| 1 | `@project-bootstrap init` (if missing `.work/`) |
| 2 | Fill `REPLACE:` in `.cursorrules` |
| 3 | `@session-control start` |
| 4 | Edit `.work/plans/NEXT.md` → one **Recommended next** row |
| 5 | Code + run test/lint/type from `.cursorrules` |
| 6 | `@code-repair repair - from uncommitted` if verify fails |
| 7 | `@session-control close` |

Upgrade: `@plan-foundation greenfield` when scope disputes appear.

## Mode: brownfield

| Step | Command |
|------|---------|
| 1 | `@project-bootstrap status` |
| 2 | `@plan-verify brownfield` |
| 3 | `@plan-repair brownfield` (optional synthesize `.work/`) |
| 4 | `@session-control start` |
| 5 | `@code-implementation plan - M1` after HANDOFF waiver or master plan |
| 6 | `@code-implementation start` → `continue` |
| 7 | `@session-control close` |

## Mode: full

| Step | Command |
|------|---------|
| 1 | `@project-bootstrap init` |
| 2 | `@plan-foundation greenfield` |
| 3 | `@plan-foundation certify plan-master-ready` |
| 4 | `@plan-master greenfield` |
| 5 | `@plan-master status` |
| 6 | `@code-implementation plan - M1` |
| 7 | `@session-control start` → implement → `close` |
